dataList.dlg: Have you found an outfit to your liking? *chuckle* Go ahead and see how it feels to the touch. They say you can't appreciate the true value of Rouge fashion until you've laid your fingertips on the material.
The Noir side has been enjoying rather warm sunshine as of late. Maybe this is the season to scrape and rip out the Golden Hide those miserable hoarders are keeping to themselves.

We use most of the flesh and hide taken from our customers for clothing. But every now and then... I like to sample some myself.
Sometimes, the only way to get a better feel for the material... is to personally experience the sensation of having them ground between your teeth... and land on your tongue.

When I take a quick stroll during the off seasons, I often see pieces of the Golden Hide scattered throughout the department store—in the cracks on the walls, lodged inside mannequins...
Clothes fashioned from the Golden Hide tend to be the trailblazers of each trend, often becoming so influential that they characterize the whole season.

There's a limit to how many eyeballs you can rake in with simplistic metrics like high sales volume. The lower floors can scramble to clear out their stock before the season ends and call it a day, but up here... we ask the questions that really matter: who buys our product, and how do they buy it? Those stupid Noirs on the other side of the floor don't seem to get that, so I have that over them.

Dear customer, surely you don't think this dress is overpriced? As it should be obvious to discerning eyes like yours, apparel of my design contains a more generous proportion of the Golden Hide. They're in an entirely different class from the clothes downstairs, which only include paltry dregs just so they can mark up their items with false advertising.

It's not that I don't sympathize with those madmen who wander my shop and their plights. The Voice that the sunshine whispered into my ears was... so warm... and kind... I felt as though it could embrace every last one of my pains.

Though that Voice was my faith, it was never my god. I prayed and prayed, but it only returned the same canned phrases, stretched thin by endless repetition.
But our new God, the cherished one... never leaves our prayers unanswered—and never fails to return questions.

When I first heard the Voice whispering in my ears... when the cherished one so graciously accepted the handkerchief I made... I felt like I was about to burst with joy.
I have faith that the cherished one will lead us, the flock, in our grief... And eventually bring us Rouges to tear off every last bit of the Golden Hide in the Grand Magasin, so that we would be comforted under its cozy blanket.
Yearn...! Consume...! The Golden Hide is wasted in the hoarding hands of the Noirs—tear them out of the walls! Every last scrap!
Don... Desire... The Voice may have faded, but I can't seem to forget it.
By my own hand, I will fell anything that dares stand in the cherished one's path.
If this be my calling...!
Hm... Most places'll turn you away if you show up in that getup. Why don't you stop by my shop sometime?
Whisper your Voice to me again!
Stupid...
Nailed down... once again...
And... to the exit you go!
Ah... I collapse to the ground again...
The cherished one's awakening at the Cradle has enabled this success.
... My faith isn't so weak as to be shaken by this setback.

Le Rouge... has surpassed Le Noir in sales for this season. But this is not nearly enough to satisfy the cherished one. This campaign will never end, not until we've torn away every last piece of the Noirs' Golden Hide and claimed it for ourselves...

It took many Seasons, but thanks to the cherished one's blessing, the Noirs on this floor will finally be shown to the exit.
All right, then. It's high time for a renovation—let's do away with this sad, depressingly Noir interior and replace it all with the flamboyant, Rouge beauty. We'll have even more customers clamoring for the fashion only Le Rouge can offer!
Arrgh... The Voice, I—the Voice is gone...! Why have you abandoned me?! No, no, no...! I have to... I have to recite the mantra once again. Remember the Voice... remember the Words...!
